error.title: Broken Smart Object links detected
error.description:
### Affected layers {broken_layers}
### How to repair? - **Automatic repair (Repair button):** Each broken layer is rasterised to a pixel snapshot and then re-embedded as a fresh local Smart Object. This severs the stale link and unblocks publishing, but the original source is no longer editable through the layer. - **Manual repair:** Right-click the layer in Photoshop, choose *Edit Contents* or *Relink to File / Library* and point it at the correct source, then re-run publish.
